$comment: Team-shared Claude Code settings. Personal overrides go in settings.local.json (gitignored). The `hooks` block is the vendor-specific EVENT TRIGGER (CONVENTIONS §7) over a vendor-neutral doer: when a turn ends, the doc reviewer's dry-run runs and prints its one-line report -- deterministic, no model. The neutral Python launcher (scripts/project_python.py) runs on host python3 >= 3.6 and uses this worktree's project venv or the main checkout's so fresh worktrees need no private venv; the agent package needs Python >= 3.10 (the host python3 may be 3.6).
